model: Sunny WebBox Modbus gateway (plant and gateway unit IDs 1-2)
equipment_type: Solar inverter gateway (PV plant data logger)
applies_to: Sunny WebBox firmware 1.52 or later with Modbus enabled, SMA Modbus profile as documented in WEBBOX_MODBUS-TB-US-EN-19 v1.9 (legacy product).
summary: Legacy SMA plant data logger that exposes its connected SMA inverters and sensors over Modbus TCP. Unit ID 1 is the gateway with the table that maps each detected device to a Modbus unit ID; unit ID 2 holds plant-wide values such as total and daily yield, plant AC power and plant time. Per-device data sit under unit IDs 3-247 (see the separate common-device map).

addressing.note: The assignment tables give 'ADR (DEC)', the decimal Modbus register address, which is sent unchanged in the request (the manual's gateway example reads device 1 at 42109). 30xxx entries are read-only values, 40xxx entries are writable parameters; the WebBox accepts FC03 and FC04 for reads.

source.title: SUNNY WEBBOX Modbus Interface - Technical Description
source.pages: pp. 14-19 (unit IDs, data types, formats), pp. 22-27 (gateway and plant tables), pp. 74-75 (port, timing)

notes: Word order: the manual's data-type figures put bits 31..16 in the first register and bits 15..0 in the second (64-bit: bits 63..48 first), and data are sent big-endian, so 32/64-bit values are high word first (ABCD).
Format to scale: FIX0 = x1, FIX1 = x0.1, FIX2 = x0.01, FIX3 = x0.001, TEMP = one decimal (x0.1), DT = UTC seconds since 1970-01-01, Duration = seconds.
NaN (no value): U16 0xFFFF, S16 0x8000, U32 0xFFFFFFFF, S32 0x80000000, U64 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF.
Multi-register values must be read in one request. SMA recommends at least 10 s between data requests and no more than 30 registers per transfer.
Unit ID 1 answers 30001/30003/30007/30057 and the assignment table; unit ID 2 answers the same four plus the plant values. Both are listed once here.
Only assignment slots 1 and 2 are listed. Slot n starts at 42109 + 4 x (n-1) (Device-ID, 2-register serial number, Unit ID); the table runs to slot 245 at 43085-43088.
To change a device's unit ID, write the slot's Device-ID, serial number and Unit ID registers as one block with FC16; only the Unit ID register is writable. Never assign the same unit ID twice.
Time-zone code list (section 7.6) is not reproduced.

integration.summary: Enable Modbus in the WebBox web UI, run plant detection, then read plant totals from unit ID 2 and look up each device's unit ID in the unit-1 assignment table before polling devices on unit IDs 3-247.
integration.enable: Log in to the WebBox as installer, Settings > Network, set 'Use Modbus' to Yes (default off), optionally change the port, Save. Activating Modbus assigns unit IDs to the devices already detected.
quirks: Devices detected later get unit ID 255 and cannot be reached until you assign them a unit ID 3-247 (gateway table or Data > Devices > Modbus page).
Reading a block that contains undefined registers returns NaN for those; a block with no defined register gives an exception.
setup: Keep requests at least 10 s apart and 30 registers or less per transfer.
gotchas: SMA recommends about 25 devices per WebBox (max 50).
Values from Sunny Central inverter families reach the WebBox Modbus interface with a typical delay of 8-10 s.
